theme_archetype.vibe: Industrial, Data-Dense, Professional Hardware Scanner Tool, Confident
theme_archetype.reasoning: Resellers operate in varied lighting environments (thrift stores, garage sales). A light theme with stark, high-contrast typography and data-dense tables ensures rapid scanning and decision making. Unnecessary decorations are removed to prioritize the 'Verdict' (Green/Yellow/Red).

headings.usage: App header, Main screen titles (e.g., 'Product Results', 'Profit Calculator')

data_numbers.usage: Pricing, KPIs (Active/Sold listings), ROI percentages, barcodes

hierarchy_rules: H1: text-3xl md:text-4xl leading-tight (Maximum size for mobile app)
Small Data: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500

profitable.description: Used for 'Buy' verdict and high ROI numbers

risky.description: Used for 'Maybe' verdict and average ROI numbers

bad_deal.description: Used for 'Don\'t Buy' verdict and negative/low ROI numbers

layout_spacing.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden bg-slate-50 shadow-2xl
layout_spacing.grid_system: Bento-style Control Room grid for data density. grid-cols-2 gap-3 for KPIs, col-span-full for summaries.

buttons.primary_scan: w-full py-4 bg-slate-900 text-white text-lg font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: w-full py-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-semibold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2

cards.data_tile: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-1
cards.history_item: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 flex gap-3 items-center active:bg-slate-50

forms.input: w-full h-12 px-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 font-mono focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all
forms.label: text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider

chips.base: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border

components.bottom_nav: h-16 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-around px-2 pb-safe

auth.layout: Centered form, logo on top. Primary button 'Sign In'.

scanner.layout: Full-bleed camera feed, black overlay with transparent square cutout, scanning laser line. Bottom action bar for manual entry fallback.

product_results.description: The core intelligence screen for decision making.
product_results.kpi_grid: Active vs Sold counts, Avg/Low/High prices, Sell-through rate (%)
product_results.ai_card: AI suggested keywords and item condition notes
product_results.actions: Jump to Calculator, Add Note, Save to History

profit_calculator.description: Dense, fast entry form for numbers. Auto-calculates.
profit_calculator.inputs: Buy Cost, Est. Sell Price, Shipping Cost, eBay Fee %, Tax
profit_calculator.outputs: Sticky bottom banner showing Net Profit ($) and ROI (%). Dynamically colors Green/Yellow/Red based on verdict.

history.elements: List view with thumbnail, title, date, profit margin, and Tag chips (e.g., 'Whatnot', 'Facebook find', 'Pallet')

facebook_marketplace.elements: Button to deep-link out to FB Marketplace app/web, input fields to manually paste local comp prices.

icons.instructions: Use for bottom nav, action buttons, and KPI indicators. Default size 20 or 24.

auth_background.description: Warehouse shelves, useful for a highly blurred background on auth or empty states.

sample_product_1.description: Vintage camera. Use as a thumbnail in the History list or Product Results mockup.

sample_product_2.description: Sneakers box. Use as another thumbnail in the History list.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure strict adherence to APCA / WCAG AA. White text on green/red pills needs sufficient contrast. Test dark text on yellow.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: ALL buttons, inputs, tabs, list items, and result cards MUST have a descriptive data-testid (e.g., 'data-testid="scan-barcode-btn"', 'data-testid="profit-calc-buy-cost"').

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Web App simulating a mobile app. Use a mobile-first container layout (max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen).
Write code for standard React with Tailwind CSS (.js or .jsx), do NOT write React Native <View> or <Text> components.
Do NOT use HTML inputs for complex interactions; prefer Shadcn UI styled appropriately.
The UI must feel like a professional, dense 'Hardware Tool'—not a generic SaaS dashboard. Remove unnecessary padding inside data tables, use borders to separate rows.
The 'Verdict' colors (Green/Yellow/Red) are mandatory and must be prominently used in the Profit Calculator output.
Every interactive element and form input MUST have a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Use the provided sample product images for the History and Results mockups.
